mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates and stimulates equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 4.5% signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns as investors anticipate corporate earnings deterioration over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a broad-based demand slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 1.0% and accelerating), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns as the Fed's policy shift dampens economic growth and corporate profits over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 1.0% and rising).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate below 4.0% indicates a tight labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 (index) signals a weakening manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and real GDP indicate a broad economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and GDPC1 decline from prior period
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST and GDPC1 both decline from prior period.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO declining for two consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns as the sector's weakness spills over to the broader economy over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during manufacturing slowdowns (INDPRO declines for two consecutive months).
